values.note: Minnesota state forest drive-in campsite, taxes included. Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground at the confluence of the east and west branches of the Baptism River beside the village of Finland, about 7 miles from Lake Superior and Tettegouche State Park, with a riverside picnic area in the village. 15 of the sites are designated for ATVs and connect directly to the Moose Walk/Moose Run and Red Dot ATV trails. Best for smaller self-contained units. Managed by Tettegouche State Park. --Claude
summary: DNR facility cmp00016 read: 39 primitive sites + 1 group site, vault toilets, well water, garbage; $17 same-day pay online (not at the campground). Individual sites FCFS; only the group site is reservable (ReserveMN). OHV side: 15 ATV-designated sites with trail access (flag, general campground). Not waterfront kept. Phone and website fixes.
flags: OHV (flag, no drop): DNR 'Highlights: 15 designated campsites in the campground allow ATVs, and provide direct access to the Moose Walk/Moose Run and Red Dot ATV trail systems.' That is 15 of 39 sites; the campground is a general state-forest campground (picnic area, river, 24 non-ATV sites) with an OHV side, so it stays with the caveat kept in the note. Reviewer to judge if the ATV share makes it a trail base.

BOOKING reservable:true / fcfs:some_sites -> reservable:false / fcfs:always: the only reservable unit is the group site (ReserveMN, 120 days); every individual site is first come with same-day online payment. Booking note names the group-site route.

FEES note corrected: the stored note said 'paid at the campground'; the DNR fee page says 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site' and payment is online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station. Rate $17 unchanged.
SITES count 39 -> 40 (39 individual + 1 group, matching how group sites are counted elsewhere). Reviewer may prefer 39.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept. On imagery the campground loops sit east of the west branch of the Baptism River (about 15-25 m wide here, creek-sized) in mixed forest; the nearest loop roads are 60-100 m from the river through trees, and no site can be named or placed on open ground at the water. No upgrade.
PHONE missing: DNR facility record names the manager as Tettegouche State Park, 218-353-8800. Suggest 218-353-8800.
